The path defines a closed shape with four vertices: (50,45), (77,45), (77,33), (50,33).  
These points form a quadrilateral with horizontal and vertical sides only.  
The coordinates show parallel sides (top and bottom horizontal, left and right vertical) and all interior angles are 90°.  
The horizontal side length is 27 units (77-50), and the vertical side length is 12 units (45-33).  
Thus, it is a rectangle.  

Final answer: (H)
